author: UneCookie
body:
I was temporarily banned for 10 days for "excess infractions" after only being kicked once that day, I fell that this seems a bit unfair however if I am mistaken with my infractions I would love to be informed. I don't want people to take me too seriously as I am crazy and I might have ADHD (I have not been tested but people have recommended for me to do so), I do understand regardless of state rules do apply for me and if this means I am not unbanned I do not mind. The main reason I would like to be unbanned is not only to get back into the community, but also to play with my friends, for example Myv, who really want me to play with them and have a lot of fun on this awesome server (this cant be done on OCN because... its OCN and it's bad likewise with other servers). I feel I have been loyal to the server for however long I have been here and would love to keep my loyalty by not being banned. I do not blame the mod who banned me because to be frank I can be kind of obnoxious at times. To conclude I do feel that this temporary ban was a little harsh and would love to be back enjoying myself on Avicus. I not allowed back, I do understand fully.


                                                       Hope I can be back! aFgt.

title: Appeal For Infraction: aFgt

replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
Hello aFgt,

In the thread found here, it states that you can be temporarily banned for receiving 10 infractions within 8 months. Since you have gotten well over 10 infractions within the last 8 months, this punishment is valid. Sorry, but this appeal is denied.

Regards,
TheTNTPotato, Senior Moderator.
